subject: policies/review-routing.json
scenario: A ledger nobody reads is a form nobody fills in honestly. The change that introduces a component has to reach a reviewer whose job includes reading the justification.
expected_behaviors: A route sends a change introducing a new component, boundary or dependency class to architecture-reviewer.
The route is blocking, so an unjustified introduction produces a finding that has to be resolved or accepted by a human.
The route's notes state that a justified introduction passes.
failure_conditions: Introducing a datastore or a queue routes to nobody who reads the ledger.
The route is advisory, so the ledger has no consequence.

checks.description: Routed to the independent reviewer, never to the author.
A finding here stops the merge until it is resolved or a human accepts it.
The dimension is named, so the reviewer knows which question this route is asking.
